minimal_boundary: Protected server owns the authorized P07 source-relation decision, F7 temporal comparison, canonical receipt re-execution, and the only positive reliance/commit journal. A Python client receipt is informational and cannot authorize.

trust_root.owner: HQ-authorized protected F7 gate service, immutable accepted exact P07/F7 semantic code blobs and exact authority bootstrap corpus; trusted job provisioner and consumer inside server protection domain
trust_root.upstream: Accepted source universe, relation refs, authority snapshots, governed release/context identity and trusted job association from independently authorized upstream owner; client-provided purported registry entries never treated as authority
trust_root.code: Server starts from pinned audited package/tree/image hash and pinned CPython/OS service binary, verifying startup manifest; no executable dependency writable by attacker
trust_root.OS: Separate protected service account/sandbox from the untrusted caller, restrictive executable/credential/file permissions; AF_UNIX peers authenticated by OS credential APIs (macOS implementation to be independently qualified); per-connection ACL and permission checks
trust_root.failure_if_same_user: Do not claim T2 if arbitrary same-user process can ptrace/debug, signal, modify service binaries, read service secrets or invoke privileged provisioning; OS boundary must actually block these.

format.encoding: Canonical sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON using existing PRE553 canonicalize for all semantic material; length-prefixed transport with strict byte and structure limits and rejection of duplicate JSON member names/unknown schema fields; no pickle or eval

request.rule_version: PYAT_HQ211_F7_TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY@1.1.0 plus pinned P07 I07 contract and exact accepted binaries
request.resolver_owner_id: Opaque identifier provisioned and bound server-side to registered job/owner at trusted creation, never accepted as freely substitutable proof merely because caller presents its string
request.job_ref: Exact trusted job identity; caller may locate but not create authoritatively
request.request_id: Unique per job; prevents reuse; domain-separated from F7 semantic receipt identity
request.request_nonce: Challenge or monotonically checked transport nonce; used for reply correlation and anti-replay, not interpreted as new F7 semantic field
request.f7_request_projection: Full exact TemporalComparisonRequest field projection (see pre553_temporal_comparability.py:686-739) excluding live Python source_relation_resolver object, replaced by trusted server owner lookup; no defaulting of missing authority refs or source/material identity
request.authority_request_refs: Full accepted AuthorityRefs needed by F7 (TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY, temporal evidence/order, estimand/measure, target use, uncertainty/replay/native mapping/source equivalence as required)
request.source_universe_refs: Exactly two full kind/object_id/content_hash refs in accepted anchor order; exact source pair derived at server
request.no_implicit_authority: No source-equivalence, target use, temporal currentness, pooling or actor authority is produced by this protocol

response.server_sequence: Trusted server monotone job-scoped sequence and durable anti-replay journal
response.semantic_state: If F7 receipt exists, exactly one existing F7 relation_state; protocol-level refusal statuses are not new F7 states
response.identity: The existing receipt_hash remains SHA256(existing canonical F7 as_material()) unchanged; transport uses separate domain-separated envelope commitment to exact request/job/owner/nonce/version/sequence/receipt_hash
response.optional_MAC: If result traverses an untrusted relay to a separately trusted consumer, service authenticates envelope with key unavailable to untrusted Python (or recipient independently fetches trusted journal); verification MUST be outside compromised Python. MAC/signature optional when trusted consumer reads same protected internal journal directly.

format.versioning: Pinned exact P07/F7 semantic contract ids and binary/package hashes in service startup; protocol major mismatch fails closed; accepted semantic version changes require independent authority and replay migration, never latest/default
format.size_limits: Explicit bounded JSON payload, bounded canonical material nesting and ref count; exact limits to be fixed in separate implementation commission, not used as new empirical/semantic thresholds

provision_and_bootstrap: Trusted provisioner imports accepted exact AuthoritySnapshot and SourceUniverseRelation material from governed source/release record; verifies immutable ref/hash/replay and exact authoritative scope independently of untrusted client

Trusted provisioner issues service-private job_ref, source/release/owner mapping and resolver_owner_id; seals P07 by-ref/by-key and pinned snapshots inside service-owned process; absence stays DISTINCT_BY_DEFAULT
Untrusted client cannot invoke bootstrap/owner registration with an arbitrary 'positive' snapshot or transfer one job's registered source resolver to a different victim job by supplying an id string

Server computes P07 owner decision using protected accepted implementation, cross-binds relation kind SOURCE_SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENCE, exact universe pair, SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENCE_ADMISSION, EXACT_BOUND_UNIVERSE_PAIR, governed_use_id.object_id and pinned snapshot/hash

Server computes F7 using the accepted compare_temporal_anchors and all independently resolved temporal authorities/order/identity/quantity/effective-time material; no client-side pre-computed state is trusted

Server independently reruns F7 deterministic replay/cross-field receipt validation, verifies exact result identity, then atomically appends one trusted acceptance record (positive/nonpositive/refusal) for this exact job/request to protected journal

Trusted consumer inside service or separately isolated attested recipient reads the authenticated journal/response for the right job/request/owner. It alone may rely on the F7 result. Client UI bytes are nonauthoritative.

old_and_new_call_graph.old: untrusted/caller Python -> Python SourceRelationResolver/lexical ledger -> Python authenticated_source_relation_decision -> F7 Python compare_temporal_anchors -> caller-observed TemporalRelationReceipt (no protected relying consumer)
old_and_new_call_graph.new: trusted upstream provisioning -> isolated owner service seal(job,real exact owner) -> untrusted Python submits candidate request -> protected server P07 decision -> protected server F7 compare -> protected replay/cross-field verify -> protected accept/reject journal -> trusted consumer inside/at trusted port; client receives display-only report
old_and_new_call_graph.critical_reliance: Do not permit untrusted Python to call a bare 'verify' or 'record accepted' method with a supplied positive receipt and have the final caller result trusted; recipient verification must be non-bypassable within trusted endpoint
old_and_new_call_graph.same_interpreter_shadows: Replacing _authenticated_source_relation_decide, compare_temporal_anchors.__code__, result.material(), replay verifier or client-side receipt does not change protected journal

P07_scope.pairs: full exact source_universe_refs and exact relation_ref, not claimant names

temporal.identity_contract: exact ref plus owner-resolved comparison evidence with hash
temporal.order: CALENDAR_TOTAL_ORDER or FAMILY_LOCAL_ORDINAL may authorize direction; PARTIAL_ORDER_NO_DIRECTION no direction; ORDER_UNKNOWN_NONCOMPARABLE terminal
temporal.delta: exact signed only, exact zero = NO_AUTHORIZED_CHANGE, no epsilon

exact_binding.replay: full trusted job and request identity + P07 custody/snapshot semantics + F7 exact receipt identity + server sequence; no cross-job/source/release replay
exact_binding.provenance: retain existing F7 receipt schema (18 accepted material fields plus hash); put job/nonce/transport identity in OUTER attestation envelope, not new F7 semantic relation fields
exact_binding.negatives: Preserve existing nine F7 negative states and typed no-receipt exceptions, separate transport/service envelope refusals

threats_and_countermeasures.attack: copy legitimate source resolver_owner_id into empty victim's request
threats_and_countermeasures.response: server binds job_ref and owner id from trusted provisioned job mapping; mismatch refused independently of provided id

threats_and_countermeasures.attack: submit source genuine authority snapshot into victim's client payload
threats_and_countermeasures.response: server ignores client-issued authority as custody; compares only server-registered trusted snapshots and relation set for victim

threats_and_countermeasures.attack: modify Python __code__ or module-global P07/F7 aliases
threats_and_countermeasures.response: server runs separate pinned trusted executable; protected journal unchanged

threats_and_countermeasures.attack: replace/fabricate Python receipt_hash or positive state
threats_and_countermeasures.response: client report cannot write protected acceptance ledger; verifier inside server independently computes and commits

threats_and_countermeasures.attack: replay a previously positive signed/MACed server packet for a new job/target/use
threats_and_countermeasures.response: job_ref+owner_id+request_id+nonce+source/release/target/use/operation/scope in attested envelope; monotone one-time seq replay gate at trusted consumer

threats_and_countermeasures.attack: valid IPC response returned but final Python consumer patched to accept forged receipt
threats_and_countermeasures.response: that Python consumer is NOT a trusted relying consumer under T2; positive reliance only in server/trusted recipient; otherwise model fails

threats_and_countermeasures.attack: OS peer spoof or service binary tampering
threats_and_countermeasures.response: service separate trust domain with protected bootstrap, OS ACL, credentials and image hash; if no such separation available, T2 claim blocked rather than green

production_transition.existing_receipt: TemporalRelationReceipt module-local, not a public object family; not already independently authenticated
production_transition.service: NEW protected F7 service executable and trusted journal/acceptance gate; relocate existing owner code as one authoritative server implementation; avoid duplicating P07/F7 semantic authority in client
production_transition.client: NEW non-authoritative typed adapter, cannot call old Python local compare for trusted effect; old local API may remain diagnostic/test-only if explicit
production_transition.downstream: No production F8/V3 actor consumer adopted. Any discovered consumers must be inventoried and re-gated or declared non-authoritative; do not silently authorise new V3/F8 effect.

governed_runtime_and_portability.python: Governed CPython 3.11.3 macOS x86_64 interpreter sha256 11d6f541a870a141249ce98d45834a6789e29c07031e85ce17f3e67f24c535f6 for retained P07/F7 semantics qualification; separate server package/image hash also mandatory
governed_runtime_and_portability.IPC: macOS AF_UNIX or protected local socket with real peer process credential/OS ACL verification; actual macOS implementation and separate-user permissions must be tested (not asserted as already proven); linux cross-port optional and requires distinct OS credential implementation
governed_runtime_and_portability.permissions: If the same attacker UID can load arbitrary code into protected server or modify service runtime/files/credentials, service is NOT T2 isolated; confirm OS security design explicitly
governed_runtime_and_portability.CI: source-free contract-canonical replay and protocol tests wherever available; governed macOS qualification and service isolation/adversarial process tests separately required; exact CI runner capability not yet verified
governed_runtime_and_portability.build: No native C extension required if P07/F7 Python executes only inside separately protected process; retained accepted semantic code blobs and env provenance must be checked
governed_runtime_and_portability.deployment_cost: trusted service lifecycle, initial seed/owner issuance, protected binary/artifact custody, IPC and journal, independent trusted consumer, packaging and monitoring are NEW architecture

cross-job/nonce/owner substitution and stale/replayed packet rejected by trusted consumer
